parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p)
insert into public.lnd_sources (
  source_key, name, source_type, base_url, official, active,
  last_checked_at, verification_status
)
select
  p->>'sourceKey', p->>'sourceName', 'LISTING', p->>'sourceUrl',
  true, true, now(), 'VERIFIED'
from payload
on conflict (source_key) do update
set name = excluded.name,
    base_url = excluded.base_url,
    active = true,
    last_checked_at = now()
returning *;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_agent_runs (
    run_key, workflow_name, workflow_version, scheduled_for,
    schedule_timezone, started_at, status, scope
  )
  select
    p->>'runKey', 'LND-WATCHER 2.0', p->>'workflowVersion',
    (p->>'scheduledFor')::timestamptz, p->>'timezone',
    now(), 'RUNNING',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'season', p->>'seasonCode',
      'source_id', p->>'sourceId',
      'mode', 'COLLECTOR'
    )
  from payload
  on conflict (run_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select r.*
from public.lnd_agent_runs r, payload
where r.run_key = payload.p->>'runKey'
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

with target_season as (
  select id, code
  from public.lnd_seasons
  where code = $1
),
villanovese as (
  select id, team_key, official_name, verification_status
  from public.lnd_teams
  where team_key = 'it-veneto:asd-villanovese'
),
next_three as (
  select
    f.id as fixture_id,
    f.scheduled_date,
    f.kickoff_time,
    f.competition_id,
    case when f.home_team_id = v.id then f.away_team_id else f.home_team_id end as opponent_team_id,
    row_number() over (
      order by f.scheduled_date, f.kickoff_time nulls last, f.id
    ) as fixture_order
  from public.lnd_fixtures f
  join target_season s on s.id = f.season_id
  cross join villanovese v
  where v.id in (f.home_team_id, f.away_team_id)
    and f.status in ('SCHEDULED', 'RESCHEDULED')
    and f.scheduled_date >= (now() at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::date
  order by f.scheduled_date, f.kickoff_time nulls last, f.id
  limit 3
),
monitor_set as (
  select
    0::bigint as monitor_order,
    v.id as team_id,
    v.team_key,
    v.official_name,
    v.verification_status,
    null::uuid as fixture_id,
    null::date as scheduled_date,
    null::uuid as competition_id
  from villanovese v
  union all
  select
    n.fixture_order,
    t.id,
    t.team_key,
    t.official_name,
    t.verification_status,
    n.fixture_id,
    n.scheduled_date,
    n.competition_id
  from next_three n
  join public.lnd_teams t on t.id = n.opponent_team_id
)
select
  s.id as season_id,
  s.code as season_code,
  coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ms) order by ms.monitor_order)
    from monitor_set ms
  ), '[]'::jsonb) as monitored_teams,
  coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', c.id,
      'competition_key', c.competition_key,
      'official_name', c.official_name,
      'kind', c.kind,
      'analytics_category', c.analytics_category,
      'verification_status', c.verification_status
    ) order by c.kind, c.official_name)
    from public.lnd_competitions c
    where c.season_id = s.id
  ), '[]'::jsonb) as competitions
from target_season s;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
previous as (
  select d.id
  from public.lnd_documents d, payload
  where d.source_id = (p->>'sourceId')::uuid
    and d.season_id = (p->>'seasonId')::uuid
    and d.bulletin_number = p->>'bulletinNumber'
    and d.content_sha256 <> lower(p->>'contentSha256')
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.lnd_documents newer
      where newer.replaces_document_id = d.id
    )
  order by d.created_at desc
  limit 1
),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_documents (
    document_key, source_id, season_id, competition_id, document_type,
    bulletin_number, published_at, canonical_url, content_sha256,
    size_bytes, mime_type, replaces_document_id, discovered_run_id,
    extraction_status, extracted_text_sha256, verification_status
  )
  select
    concat(
      p->>'sourceKey', ':',
      replace(p->>'seasonCode', '/', '-'), ':cu:',
      p->>'bulletinNumber', ':',
      left(lower(p->>'contentSha256'), 16)
    ),
    (p->>'sourceId')::uuid,
    (p->>'seasonId')::uuid,
    null,
    case when previous.id is null then 'OFFICIAL_BULLETIN' else 'RECTIFICATION' end,
    p->>'bulletinNumber',
    nullif(p->>'publishedAt', '')::timestamptz,
    p->>'canonicalUrl',
    lower(p->>'contentSha256'),
    nullif(p->>'sizeBytes', '')::bigint,
    'application/pdf',
    previous.id,
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    'TEXT',
    null,
    'PARSED'
  from payload
  left join previous on true
  on conflict (content_sha256) do nothing
  returning *, true as is_new
)
select * from inserted
union all
select d.*, false as is_new
from public.lnd_documents d, payload
where d.content_sha256 = lower(payload.p->>'contentSha256')
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sourceKey: $json.sourceKey, seasonCode: $json.seasonCode, sourceId: $json.sourceId, seasonId: $json.seasonId, bulletinNumber: $json.bulletinNumber, publishedAt: $json.publishedAt || '', canonicalUrl: $json.canonicalUrl, contentSha256: $json.contentSha256, sizeBytes: $json.sizeBytes ?? '', runId: $json.runId }) }}

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_disciplinary_measures (
    idempotency_key, document_id, page_number, source_excerpt,
    season_id, competition_id, team_id, person_id,
    raw_team_name, raw_person_name, measure_type, quantity, unit,
    gamedays, effective_from, verification_status, confidence
  )
  select
    concat('lnd-measure:', lower(p->>'measureHash')),
    (p->>'documentId')::uuid,
    nullif(p->>'pageNumber', '')::integer,
    p->>'sourceExcerpt',
    (p->>'seasonId')::uuid,
    (p->>'competitionId')::uuid,
    nullif(p->>'teamId', '')::uuid,
    null,
    nullif(p->>'rawTeamName', ''),
    nullif(p->>'rawPersonName', ''),
    p->>'measureType',
    nullif(p->>'quantity', '')::numeric,
    nullif(p->>'unit', ''),
    nullif(p->>'gamedays', '')::integer,
    nullif(p->>'effectiveFrom', '')::date,
    p->>'verificationStatus',
    nullif(p->>'confidence', '')::numeric
  from payload
  on conflict (idempotency_key) do nothing
  returning *, true as is_new
)
select * from inserted
union all
select dm.*, false as is_new
from public.lnd_disciplinary_measures dm, payload
where dm.idempotency_key = concat('lnd-measure:', lower(payload.p->>'measureHash'))
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ...$json, pageNumber: $json.pageNumber ?? '', teamId: $json.teamId ?? '', quantity: $json.quantity ?? '', unit: $json.unit ?? '', gamedays: $json.gamedays ?? '', effectiveFrom: $json.effectiveFrom ?? '', confidence: $json.confidence ?? '' }) }}

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_verifications (
    verification_key, run_id, source_id, document_id, team_id,
    result, evidence, checked_at
  )
  select
    concat('verify:', p->>'runId', ':measure:', p->>'measureId'),
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    (p->>'sourceId')::uuid,
    (p->>'documentId')::uuid,
    nullif(p->>'teamId', '')::uuid,
    case when (p->>'isNew')::boolean then 'NEW' else 'UNCHANGED' end,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'measure_id', p->>'measureId',
      'measure_type', p->>'measureType',
      'verification_status', p->>'verificationStatus'
    ),
    now()
  from payload
  on conflict (verification_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select v.*
from public.lnd_verifications v, payload
where v.verification_key = concat('verify:', payload.p->>'runId', ':measure:', payload.p->>'measureId')
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ runId: $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.runId, sourceId: $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.sourceId, documentId: $json.document_id, teamId: $json.team_id || '', measureId: $json.id, measureType: $json.measure_type, verificationStatus: $json.verification_status, isNew: $json.is_new }) }}

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_notifications (
    dedupe_key, run_id, measure_id, report_id, channel,
    destination_ref_hash, payload_sha256, payload_preview, status
  )
  select
    concat('telegram:measure:', p->>'measureId', ':', left(p->>'destinationRefHash', 16)),
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    (p->>'measureId')::uuid,
    null,
    'TELEGRAM',
    p->>'destinationRefHash',
    lower(p->>'payloadSha256'),
    left(p->>'telegramMessage', 1000),
    case when coalesce((p->>'telegramEnabled')::boolean, false)
      then 'PENDING' else 'SKIPPED' end
  from payload
  on conflict (dedupe_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select n.*
from public.lnd_notifications n, payload
where n.dedupe_key = concat(
  'telegram:measure:', payload.p->>'measureId', ':',
  left(payload.p->>'destinationRefHash', 16)
)
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p)
update public.lnd_notifications n
set
  status = case when nullif(p->>'error', '') is null then 'SENT' else 'FAILED' end,
  attempt_count = n.attempt_count + 1,
  provider_message_id = nullif(p->>'providerMessageId', ''),
  sent_at = case when nullif(p->>'error', '') is null then now() else n.sent_at end,
  last_error = nullif(left(p->>'error', 1000), '')
from payload
where n.id = (p->>'notificationId')::uuid
returning n.*;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ notificationId: $('Queue Telegram Measure').item.json.id, providerMessageId: $json.result?.message_id || $json.message_id || '', error: $json.error?.message || $json.error || '' }) }}

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
inserted as (
  insert into public.lnd_verifications (
    verification_key, run_id, source_id, document_id,
    result, evidence, checked_at
  )

    concat('verify:', p->>'runId', ':document:', p->>'documentId'),
    (p->>'runId')::uuid,
    (p->>'sourceId')::uuid,
    (p->>'documentId')::uuid,
    case
      when p->>'result' in ('NOT_FOUND', 'AMBIGUOUS') then p->>'result'
      else 'NOT_FOUND'

    coalesce(p->'evidence', '{}'::jsonb),
    now()
  from payload
  on conflict (verification_key) do nothing
  returning *
)
select * from inserted
union all
select v.*
from public.lnd_verifications v, payload
where v.verification_key = concat(
  'verify:', payload.p->>'runId', ':document:', payload.p->>'documentId'
)
  and not exists (select 1 from inserted)
limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ runId: $json.runId || $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.runId, sourceId: $json.sourceId || $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.sourceId, documentId: $json.documentId || $('Register Document').item.json.id, result: $json.verificationResult || 'NOT_FOUND', evidence: $json.evidence || { reason: 'NESSUNA_MENZIONE_RILEVANTE' } }) }}

parameters.query:
with payload as (select $1::jsonb as p),
source_update as (
  update public.lnd_sources s
  set last_success_at = now(), last_checked_at = now()
  from payload
  where s.id = (p->>'sourceId')::uuid
  returning s.id
),
counts as (
  select
    (select count(*) from public.lnd_verifications v, payload
      where v.run_id = (payload.p->>'runId')::uuid) as documents_seen,
    (select count(*) from public.lnd_documents d, payload
      where d.discovered_run_id = (payload.p->>'runId')::uuid) as documents_new,
    (select count(*)
      from public.lnd_disciplinary_measures dm
      join public.lnd_documents d on d.id = dm.document_id,
      payload
      where d.discovered_run_id = (payload.p->>'runId')::uuid) as measures_new,
    exists (
      select 1 from public.lnd_notifications n, payload
      where n.run_id = (payload.p->>'runId')::uuid
        and n.status = 'FAILED'
    ) as has_failed_notification
)
update public.lnd_agent_runs r
set
  finished_at = now(),
  status = case when counts.has_failed_notification then 'PARTIAL' else 'SUCCEEDED' end,
  documents_seen = counts.documents_seen,
  documents_new = counts.documents_new,
  measures_new = counts.measures_new
from counts, payload
where r.id = (payload.p->>'runId')::uuid
returning r.*;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ runId: $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.runId, sourceId: $('Build Runtime Context').first().json.sourceId }) }}
